This is a routine post-install hook that adjusts a system service (irqbalance) directly related to the package's stated purpose (a custom kernel with in-kernel IRQ balancing). It only acts when the service is explicitly enabled, gracefully returns on any failure, and leaves a running irqbalance instance alone until the next reboot.

There are no signs of malicious behavior: no network requests, no obfuscation, no data exfiltration, no downloads of external code, no `eval`/`base64`/`curl`/`wget`, no tampering with unrelated system files. The HTML entities in the rendered content (e.g., `>`, `<`, `&`, `"`) are just standard shell operators (`>`, `<`, `&`, `"`); they are not evidence of anything unusual.
</details>
<evidence>
